title: IntelligenceDrawer — Tight Cut, Chug, Resonance, Follower, Lock-In panels
description:
Implement the collapsible Guitar Intelligence side drawer housing Tight Cut, Chug Stabilizer, Resonance Scan, Note Follower, and Mix Lock-In module panels per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §13.6 and related control sections §6–§10.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §13.6 drawer requirements; §6 Tight Cut controls; §7 Chug Stabilizer; §8 resonance scan workflow; §9 note follower; §10 external-sidechain Mix Lock-In
- Source/ParameterIDs.h corresponding parameter ID groups
- Source/UI/ShredEQLookAndFeel.* from j.1
- existing DSP public status getters if any (TightCut, ChugStabilizer, ResonanceSuppressor, NoteFollower, MaskingCarver) for status readouts — display only

Implement Source/UI/IntelligenceDrawer.h and Source/UI/IntelligenceDrawer.cpp:
1. Collapsible side panel Component with open/closed width animation or instant toggle (prefer simple setExpanded(bool) without mandatory animation).
2. Five sub-panels (nested Components or sections) in order: Tight Cut, Chug Stabilizer, Resonance Scan, Note Follower, Mix Lock-In.
3. Each module panel provides: enable toggle, status/readout area, primary controls, expand/deeper-editor disclosure for secondary params, audition (where parameter exists), and reset-to-default action for that module’s parameters.
4. Bind controls through APVTS attachments using existing ParameterIDs (construct with APVTS& and optional processor reference for status snapshots).
5. Resonance Scan panel: scan / apply / clear candidate UI hooks calling processor methods if available via abstract callbacks; do not reimplement detector DSP.
6. Mix Lock-In panel: masking amount/mode/collision preview-enable controls only — keep product boundary (no full multitrack host).
7. Scrollable body when content exceeds drawer height.

Do not modify PluginEditor layout, EQWorkspace, InspectorPanel, or CMakeLists.txt.
acceptance_criteria: IntelligenceDrawer is a collapsible side panel with setExpanded/isExpanded (or equivalent) API
Drawer contains distinct sections for Tight Cut, Chug Stabilizer, Resonance Scan, Note Follower, and Mix Lock-In
Each module section includes enable, primary controls, deeper/secondary disclosure, and reset action hooks
Controls attach to APVTS parameters via ParameterIDs rather than inventing a parallel parameter store
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Source/PluginProcessor.* DSP wiring beyond read-only status includes (prefer callbacks; do not edit processor)
expand product into full multitrack masking host

allowed: nested section Components inside one drawer translation unit
callback interfaces for scan/apply/clear/audition when processor methods are not yet stable
